The laboratory operates as a health institution capable of validating in-house developed tests as required by the CE-IVD regulation. The services include analysis of both constitutional samples and malignancies. The laboratory provides sequencing services mainly using local sequencing capacity (Illumina NovaSeq 6000, NovaSeq X Plus, Ion GeneStudio S5 Prime equipment). The large cancer panel test is intended for detection of small nucleotide variants (SNVs), indels, gene fusions, copy number variations (CNVs), microsatellite instability (MSI), homologous recombination deficiency (HRD), and tumor mutation burden (TMB) relevant for the genetic profiling of solid tumor samples and/or hematological malignancies as well as plasma samples for cfDNA analysis. Sequencing of the samples is carried out using Illumina NovaSeq sequencers (Illumina NovaSeq 6000 and NovaSeq X Plus). The number of cancer panel tests performed annually is estimated to be between 2500-3000. The procurement is divided into LOT A and LOT B: LOT A - This lot includes gene panel solutions for in-house NGS testing of solid tumors and hematological malignancies, including library preparation reagents, target enrichment reagents defining the panel content, panel-specific reagents, data analysis software, and instructions for use. Sequencing reagents, flow cells, sequencing instruments, and testing services are not included in this procurement. - This test is based on analysis of total nucleic acids (RNA and/or DNA) extracted from paraffin embedded specimens and/or fresh-frozen specimens - This lot includes an option for special gene panel and reagents for salivary gland tumors with data analysis software - This lot includes an an option for a custom gene panel and reagents with data analysis software - The HUS Group will decide separately on the use of the options LOT B - This lot includes gene panel solutions for in-house NGS testing of cell-free DNA, including library preparation reagents, target enrichment reagents defining the panel content, panel-specific reagents, data analysis software, and instructions for use. Sequencing reagents, flow cells, sequencing instruments, and testing services are not included in this procurement - This test is based on analysis of cell-free DNA from plasma samples NOTE: For LOT A, the tenderer may offer a catalog panel, a combination of catalog panels, or a custom solution to meet the DNA and RNA requirements. For hematological malignancies, only a panel for DNA is requested. Panel for salivary gland tumors and custom panel are requested as an option. NOTE: FOR LOT A and LOT B, the tender needs to include all the reagents required to perform the assay, including library preparation reagents, indexing adapters and target enrichment reagents (or equivalent). Nucleic acid extraction reagents, library quantification reagents and sequencer reagents are excluded from the tender. The subject of the procurement and its requirements are described in more detail in the call for tender and its appendices. The tenderer can submit a tender to either one or both of the LOTS A and LOT B. The tenderer can be awarded the contract to either one or both tendered lots. The contrcting entity selects one (1) supplier for each lot and will enter into an agreement with the winning supplier. The estimated start for the contract period is autumn-winter 2026. The contracting entity recieves a right to test use tendered panels and softwares after the deadline for receiving the tenders. The procurement volumes presented in the call for tenders are estimates, and the contract does not constitute a mandatory purchase obligation for the contrcting entity or an exclusive right for the supplier to provide the product.

title-proc.eng: 10006175 - Advancing Regional Circular Economy in Indonesia

description-proc.eng: The challenge Our planet"s resources are limited, and environmental pollution is on the rise. The OECD projects that plastics and packaging consumption will nearly double by 2050, underscoring the urgent need to transition from a linear "take-make-dispose" economy to a circular one. Our predominant linear model depletes finite resources, generates escalating waste volumes, and strains ecosystems, with only 9% of plastic waste globally being recycled as per UNEP reports. A circular economy (CE), on the other hand, emphasises on resource efficiency through reuse, recycling, and recovery, offers a sustainable alternative to mitigate environmental degradation and optimise material lifecycles. In Indonesia, where local governments struggle with providing waste management services and infrastructure that needs to keep pace with rapid urbanisation and consumption growth, adopting circular principles is critical to addressing mounting environmental and economic challenges. Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) is pivotal in operationalising a circular economy by enforcing the Polluter Pays Principle (PPP), compelling producers to internalise the costs of managing their products" end-of-life waste. By implementing a dual system for packaging and other waste streams, EPR shifts the financial burden from overburdened municipal budgets to producers, incentivising eco-design and efficient waste management. In Indonesia, where inadequate financing hampers effective waste collection and processing, resulting in over 60% of plastic waste being mismanaged (World Bank, 2021), EPR offers a mechanism to secure sustainable funding and enhance operational capacity, ensuring that waste is managed responsibly and diverted from landfills, rivers, and oceans. Our approach InCircular supports the implementation of Indonesia"s Circular Economy Roadmap and National Action Plan 2025-2045 (Bappenas, 2024) which emphasises circularity for key sectors to address climate change, biodiversity loss, pollution, and enhancing resource efficiency. By fostering multi stakeholder collaboration among government, private sector, and civil society to develop EPR frameworks, the project supports the Indonesian government"s objective of creating inclusive, evidence-based policies that strengthen economic resilience and sustainable resource management. InCircular aims to unite a diverse coalition of stakholders to jointly develop strategies, policies, and an operating system that fit to the Indonesian context. By fostering stakeholder dialogue and leveraging German and global best practices, the project seeks to deliver actionable policy recommendations to the Indonesian government, paving the way for systemic change in waste management financing and operations while promoting a circular economy that benefits both the environment and society. InCircular works towards 5 outputs: 1. Support the coordination of the implementation of the Circular Economy Roadmap and Action Plan; 2. Enhance regulatory frameworks for EPR and selected material streams (packaging, residual waste, e-waste); 3. Strengthen collaboration with industry partners for the transition to a Circular Economy; 4. Improve waste management in selected provinces and municipalities; 5. Advance Green/Sustainable Public Procurement (G/SPP) for selected goods. The benefits InCircular will address crucial challenges in policymaking to make polluters pay. Thereby, it creates a new income stream to further transform waste management financing on local and national level which would enhance economic growth and activities in a systemically underfunded sector. This will alleviate public budgets, reduce pollution and create economic opportunities within material value chains.

title-proc.eng: Copenhagen - New Metroline, M5 Transportation System

description-proc.eng: This tender presents a substantial opportunity for prospective contractors to bid for the M5 Transportation System South package (TSS), a critical component of the Copenhagen metro system's expansion. This project is of significant strategic importance, as the M5 line is a fully automated driverless metro system that will not only enhance passenger service on existing metro corridors but is also planned to extend connectivity to emerging urban development areas, including Kløverparken, Refshaleøen, and Lynetteholm in the East Harbour. The M5 is to operate as an independent system, ensuring that its construction and subsequent operation do not disrupt the existing M1-M4 metro lines. The current tender, Phase 1, encompasses the southern section of the line, from København H to north of v/Prags Boulevard, with an anticipated operational commencement in 2036. The broader vision includes the northern section with an anticipated operatonal commencement of the last part of the northern section in 2045 (included in the transportation system contract (TSS-contract) as options) and a potential future extension to form a ring line, signifying a long-term commitment to urban mobility. The procurement comprises the following, together constituting a mixed procurement within the meaning of Article 5 (2) of the Utilities Directive: 1) A TRANSPORTATION SYSTEM for M5 south encompassing the subsystems rolling stock (passenger vehicles, service vehicles and rescue trolleys), railway infrastructure (signaling system and other subsystems, excluding permanent way and power supply "on the line"), and a CMC (control and maintenance center). Furthermore, O&M supplies (supplies related to the O&M providers operation and maintenance activities such as maintenance plans and training). “On the line” refers to deliveries outside the CMC (as the Transportation System Contractor (TSC) is itself responsible for power supply and permanent way within the CMC). The integration of the mentioned TS-subsystems and the integration of the scope of supply of the CWC into the Transportation System (including but not limited to permanent way and power supply on the line) is also part of the TSC's responsibilities and forms part of the TSS-contract. Rolling stock, railway Infrastructure and the CMC are further described in M5-2-TSS-SW (Scope of Work) of the tender material. 2) MAINTENANCE SERVICES following hand over of the Transportation System related to the continued maintenance of the Transportation System (hereinafter Maintenance Services). The TSS-contract covers both the Transportation System and the Maintenance Services. The Maintenance Services are governed by a separate maintenance contract forming an attachment to the TSS-contract (hereinafter Maintenance Contract) The purchase of the Transportation System and the Maintenance Services should therefore be seen as a whole and only one Tenderer will be awarded the contracts. The expected scope and characteristics of the two contracts are described in the tender material. 3) OPTIONS Three (3) options are included in the TSS-contract: Option 1: The purchase of 5 additional passenger vehicles. Option 2: The extension of the transportation system from Prags Boulevard to Refshaleøen. Option 3: The extension of the transportation system from Refshaleøen to Lynetteholm. Metroselskabet’s requirements relating to the Transportation System are set out in the tender documents, including the draft TSS-contract and the Scope of Works document (M5-2-TSS.SW). Requirements may be developed and changed during the competitive dialogue. As regards the Maintenance Contract, no draft contract or draft specifications are included in the Tender Documents at this stage. This reflects the fact that a central element of the competitive dialogue will be to explore the scope and structure of the Maintenance Contract, including the distribution of maintenance tasks between the TS Contractor and the future operator of the Transportation System (hereinafter the OAMC). As a central element of the dialogue phase, the Employer wishes to explore the advantages and implications of possible distributions of maintenance tasks between the TS Contractor and the OAMC and the technical, commercial and legal terms that will be relevant depending on the maintenance model chosen. The potential models to be discussed and assessed during the dialogue phase are expected to span from a scope of the Maintenance Contract similar to TSSSA models (“Technical Support and Spares Supply Agreements”) to a scope similar to FSA models (“Full Service Agreements”) whereby the Employer would procure most goods, works and services needed for the maintenance and continued development of the Transportation System from the TS Contractor. However, also models which are “in between” or a model where the scope will change over time may be chosen. Also the options to purchase additional passenger vehicles and options covering the extension of the line (northern section) are subject to dialogue. Both technical and commercial requirements are expected to be discussed including elements related to pricing. For further detailing of items planned to be subject for dialogue, reference is made to the Instructions to Tenderers (M5-0-TSS-ITT).

description-proc.lav: Ņemot vērā tendences un tirgus cerības mūsdienu digitālajā pasaulē, Eiropas Investīciju fonds ir apņēmies izveidot spēcīgu tiešsaistes klātbūtni, kas cita starpā ietver sociālos plašsaziņas līdzekļus. description-proc.hun: A mai digitális világban megfigyelhető tendenciák és piaci elvárások nyomán az Európai Beruházási Alap elkötelezett az erős online jelenlét kiépítése mellett, amely többek között a közösségi médiára is kiterjed. Az elérendő eredményeknek mindig tükrözniük kell az EBA értékeit, és a lehető legjobban elő kell segíteniük az EBA és az EU annak érdekében végzett munkáját, hogy a finanszírozást hozzáférhetővé tegye az európai kkv-k számára.
description-proc.gle: Agus é á spreagadh ag treochtaí agus ionchais an mhargaidh i saol digiteach an lae inniu, tá an Ciste Eorpach Infheistíochta tiomanta do láithreacht láidir ar líne a chruthú, a chuimseoidh na meáin shóisialta, i measc gnéithe eile. description-proc.ell: Με βάση τις τάσεις και τις προσδοκίες της αγοράς στον σημερινό ψηφιακό κόσμο, το Ευρωπαϊκό Ταμείο Επενδύσεων έχει δεσμευθεί να δημιουργήσει μια ισχυρή διαδικτυακή παρουσία που θα καλύπτει, μεταξύ άλλων, τα μέσα κοινωνικής δικτύωσης. Στο γενικότερο αυτό πλαίσιο, το ΕΤαΕ προκηρύσσει πρόσκληση υποβολής προσφορών για την παροχή υπηρεσιών παροχής συμβουλών σε κοινωνικά μέσα, δημιουργίας περιεχομένου και παραγωγής. Σε συνεργασία με τη Διεύθυνση Μάρκετινγκ του ΕΤαΕ, οι πάροχοι υπηρεσιών θα συμβάλλουν στη δημιουργία και την παράδοση εκστρατειών κοινωνικών μέσων για το κοινό από τη σύλληψη, την ανάπτυξη στρατηγικής, τη δημιουργία και παραγωγή περιεχομένου, την προώθηση επί πληρωμή, την ανάλυση, την αναφορά και τη διαχείριση κοινότητας. Τα παραδοτέα πρέπει πάντα να αντικατοπτρίζουν τις αξίες του ΕΤΕ και να βοηθούν στην προώθηση με τον καλύτερο τρόπο του έργου του ΕΤαΕ και της ΕΕ για τη διάθεση χρηματοδότησης στις ΜΜΕ στην Ευρώπη.
description-proc.spa: El Fondo Europeo de Inversiones, impulsado por las tendencias y las expectativas del mercado en el mundo digital actual, se ha comprometido a crear una fuerte presencia en línea que abarque, entre otras cosas, los medios sociales. En este contexto, el FEI lanza una licitación para la prestación de servicios de asesoramiento en materia de medios sociales, creación y producción de contenidos. En colaboración con la División de Marketing del FEI, los proveedores de servicios contribuirán a la creación y realización de campañas de medios sociales para públicos específicos, desde la conceptualización, el desarrollo de estrategias, la creación y producción de contenidos, la promoción remunerada, el análisis, la elaboración de informes y la gestión de comunidades. Los resultados deben reflejar siempre los valores del FEI y contribuir a promover de la mejor manera posible el trabajo que realizan el FEI y la UE para poner la financiación a disposición de las pyme en Europa.
description-proc.est: Tänapäevase digimaailma suundumustest ja turuootustest ajendatuna on Euroopa Investeerimisfondi (EIF) eesmärk luua kindel ja püsiv esindatus internetis, mis hõlmab muu hulgas ka sotsiaalmeediat. EIF kuulutab seda arvestades välja hankemenetluse sotsiaalmeedia valdkonnas nõustamise, sisu loomise ja tootmisega seotud teenuste hankimiseks. Teenuseosutajad aitavad koostöös EIFi turundusüksusega kaasa sihtrühmapõhiste sotsiaalmeediakampaaniate loomisele ja elluviimisele alates kavandamisest, strateegia väljatöötamisest, sisu loomisest ja tootmisest, tasulisest müügiedendusest, analüüsist, aruandlusest ja kogukonna haldamisest. Tulemid peaksid alati kajastama EIFi väärtusi ja aitama parimal viisil edendada EIFi ja ELi tegevust VKEdele rahastamise kättesaadavaks tegemisel Euroopas.
description-proc.nld: Door trends en marktverwachtingen in de huidige digitale wereld ze het Europees Investeringsfonds zich in om een sterke online aanwezigheid op te bouwen die onder meer betrekking heeft op sociale media. Tegen deze achtergrond schrijft het EIF een oproep tot inschrijving uit voor de verlening van diensten voor advies, contentcreatie en -productie voor sociale media. In samenwerking met de afdeling Marketing van het EIF dragen dienstverleners bij tot de creatie en levering van publieksspecifieke socialemediacampagnes op basis van conceptualisering, strategieontwikkeling, contentcreatie en -productie, betaalde promotie, analyse, verslaglegging en gemeenschapsbeheer. De te leveren producten moeten altijd de waarden van het EIF weerspiegelen en de werkzaamheden van het EIF en de EU bij het ter beschikking stellen van financiering aan het mkb in Europa zo goed mogelijk helpen promoten.
description-proc.fin: Nykyajan digitaalisen maailman trendien ja markkinaodotusten vauhdittamana Euroopan investointirahasto on sitoutunut olemaan vahvasti läsnä Internetissä, myös sosiaalisessa mediassa. Tätä varten EIR julkaisee tarjouspyynnön sosiaalisen median neuvontaa, sisällön luomista ja tuottamista koskevien palveluiden toimittamisesta. Työskennellessään EIR:n markkinointiosastolla palveluiden toimittajat osallistuvat sosiaalisen median kampanjoiden luomiseen ja levittämiseen kohdennetulle yleisölle. Tehtäviin kuuluu suunnittelua, strategian kehittämistä, sisällön tuottamista ja luontia, maksullista mainontaa, analyysia, raportointia ja yhteisön hallintaa. Toimituksissa on aina otettava huomioon EIR:n arvot ja edistettävä parhaalla mahdollisella tavalla EIR:n ja EU:n työ rahoituksen tarjoamiseksi pk-yrityksille Euroopassa.
description-proc.pol: Europejski Fundusz Inwestycyjny, opierający się na tendencjach i oczekiwaniach rynkowych w dzisiejszym świecie cyfrowym, zobowiązał się do zbudowania silnej obecności on-line, obejmującej między innymi media społecznościowe. W tym kontekście EFI ogłasza zaproszenie do składania ofert na świadczenie usług doradztwa w mediach społecznościowych, tworzenia i produkcji treści. We współpracy z Wydziałem ds. Marketingu EFI usługodawcy przyczynią się do stworzenia i realizacji kampanii w mediach społecznościowych kierowanych do konkretnych odbiorców, począwszy od opracowania koncepcji, opracowania strategii, tworzenia i produkcji treści, płatnej promocji, analizy, sprawozdawczości i zarządzania społecznością. Wyniki powinny zawsze odzwierciedlać wartości EFI i pomóc w jak najlepszym promowaniu pracy EFI i UE w udostępnianiu MŚP finansowania w Europie.
description-proc.hrv: S obzirom na trendove i očekivanja tržišta u današnjem digitalnom svijetu, Europski investicijski fond predan je izgradnji snažne internetske prisutnosti koja, među ostalim, pokriva društvene medije. U tom kontekstu EIF pokreće poziv na nadmetanje za pružanje usluga savjetovanja, stvaranja i proizvodnje društvenih medija. U suradnji s EIF-ovim marketinškim odjelom, pružatelji usluga će pridonijeti stvaranju i isporuci kampanja na društvenim medijima specifičnih za publiku od konceptualizacije, razvoja strategije, stvaranja i proizvodnje sadržaja, plaćene promidžbe, analitike, izvješćivanja i upravljanja zajednicom. Rezultati trebaju uvijek odražavati vrijednosti EIF-a i pomoći u najboljem promicanju rada EIF-a i EU-a u osiguravanju financijskih sredstava za MSP-ove u Europi.
description-proc.ces: Vzhledem k trendům a očekáváním trhu v dnešním digitálním světě se Evropský investiční fond zavázal vybudovat silnou on-line přítomnost, která mimo jiné zahrnuje sociální média. Právě v tomto kontextu EIF vypisuje výzvu k podávání nabídek na poskytování služeb poradenství, tvorby a produkce obsahu sociálních médií. Ve spolupráci s marketingovým oddělením EIF poskytovatelé služeb přispějí k vytvoření a realizaci cílených kampaní v sociálních médiích od konceptualizace, vývoje strategie, tvorby a produkce obsahu, placené propagace, analýz, podávání zpráv a řízení komunit. Předměty plnění by měly vždy odrážet hodnoty EIF a co nejlépe podporovat práci EIF a EU při zpřístupňování finančních prostředků malým a středním podnikům v Evropě.
description-proc.dan: På grund af tendenser og markedsforventninger i dagens digitale verden har Den Europæiske Investeringsfond forpligtet sig til at opbygge en stærk onlinetilstedeværelse, der bl.a. omfatter sociale medier. I samarbejde med EIF's marketingafdeling skal tjenesteudbydere bidrage til oprettelse og levering af målgruppespecifikke sociale mediekampagner fra konceptualisering, strategiudvikling, indholdsskabelse og -produktion, betalte annoncer, analytik, rapportering og fællesskabsforvaltning. description-proc.ron: Având la bază tendințele și așteptările pieței în lumea digitală de astăzi, Fondul European de Investiții s-a angajat să construiască o prezență online puternică care să acopere, printre altele, rețelele sociale. Realizările ar trebui să reflecte întotdeauna valorile FEI și să contribuie la promovarea în cel mai bun mod a activității FEI și a UE în punerea la dispoziția IMM-urilor din Europa a finanțării.
description-proc.por: Impulsionado pelas tendências e expetativas do mercado no mundo digital atual, o Fundo Europeu de Investimento comprometeu-se a construir uma presença em linha forte que abranja, entre outras, as redes sociais. description-proc.deu: Angetrieben von Trends und Markterwartungen in der digitalen Welt von heute hat sich der Europäische Investitionsfonds verpflichtet, eine starke Online-Präsenz aufzubauen, die unter anderem soziale Medien abdeckt. description-proc.eng: General information about the project: Pursuant to Act No. 624 of 11 June 2024 concerning the construction of a third Limfjord link, the Danish Road Directorate is constructing an approximately 20 km four-lane motorway connecting to the E45 “Nordjyske Motorvej” in the south and the E39 “Hirtshalsmotorvejen” in the north. The motorway will run west of Aalborg and cross the island of Egholm. The motorway will pass beneath the southern branch of the Limfjord (Sønderdyb) through a tunnel and cross the northern branch (Nørredyb) via low-level bridges. In addition to the approximately 2 km tunnel beneath the southern branch of the Limfjord, the project includes approximately 18 km of motorway in open countryside with two motorway interchanges, five junctions, relocation of a number of local roads and paths, demolition of bridges, reconstruction and widening of bridges, installation of noise barriers, and approximately 55 new structures, including three railway bridges, two valley bridges (twin bridges), two low-level bridges (twin bridges), and a pile-supported deck. The project also includes land reclamation in an area of the Limfjord south of Egholm. The tunnel structure consists of an immersed tunnel as the “main tunnel”, connected to the open tunnel ramps at each end via a cut-and-cover “transition tunnel”, together with associated technical buildings, tunnel basins, pumping stations, and mechanical and electrical installations (M&E). ________________________________________________________________________________________________________ Specific information regarding the contract: The contract includes construction of: • The section from approximately km 108.100–112.600, including the immersed tunnel, cut-and-cover “transition tunnel”, and tunnel ramp structure (including M&E and technical buildings), land reclamation, coastal embankment and replacement habitats, roadworks, drainage works (including stormwater retention basin), fauna crossings and a bridge over a local road on the island of Egholm, as well as the two parallel low-level bridges over Nørredyb, each approximately 660 m in length. ________________________________________________________________________________________________________ The contract includes the following works: • Site establishment • Preparatory works • Temporary works necessary for completion of the project • Civil engineering works (earthworks, bridges, tunnel and roads, drainage, technical buildings) • Specialist works (marine works, immersion of tunnel elements) • Mechanical and electrical installations • Utility works • Environmental mitigation and protective measures • Completion works (pavement, signage, safety equipment) ________________________________________________________________________________________________________ Procurement timetable: The contract is expected to be tendered in the third quarter of 2026. other interested parties to comment on the current draft minimum selection criteria. The purpose of this is to obtain feedback that may be taken into account in the finalisation of the requirements. The aim is to ensure that the Minimum requirements, within the framework of the project, are market-compliant and well balanced. ________________________________________________________________________________________________________ The material for the hearing can be found here: https://udbudsportalen.app.vd.dk/da/forthcoming?showDetails=3ade0e78-2022-42c6-b74c-a7fc1b3465b2 ________________________________________________________________________________________________________ Responses to the hearing should be sent to Saleebaan Yusuf at samy@vd.dk, with inbd@vd.dk in copy. title-proc.eng: Evidence reviews for the European Commission Initiatives on cancer screening and care

description-proc.eng: The Disease Prevention Unit of the European Commission’s (EC) Joint Research Centre has been assigned with tasks in the field of cancer prevention and rare diseases that include the development of new European guidelines and quality assurance schemes for the six most prevalent cancer sites (breast, cervical, colorectal, gastric, lung and prostate cancer) representing over 50% of the cancer burden in the European Union. The purpose of this procurement procedure is to provide continuity for the collection, analysis and assessment of the underpinning evidence informing the EC initiatives, following a uniform methodological framework. The purpose of Lot 1 is to perform mapping exercises (e.g. background or scoping reviews, identification of existing guidelines) and evidence reviews, including systematic reviews, synthesis and critically appraisal of evidence, and definition of Evidence to Decision frameworks (EtDs) for the development and update of guideline recommendations, with emphasis, but not exclusively, on breast, colorectal, cervical and lung cancer. The purpose of Lot 2 is to perform mapping exercises (e.g. background or scoping reviews, identification of existing quality indicators) and evidence reviews, including systematic reviews, synthesis and critically appraisal of evidence, and definition of quality indicators worksheets and requirements for the development and update of quality indicators and requirements with emphasis, but not exclusively, on breast, colorectal, cervical and lung cancer.
